descrizioneOriginale: A horse-sized insect with digging claws and acidic blood.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Burrower can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

Mark a Stress to have the Burrower burst out of the ground. All creatures within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

Make an attack against all targets in front of the Burrower within Close range. Targets the Burrower succeeds against take 2d6 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP and you gain a Fear.

When the Burrower takes Severe damage, all creatures within Close range are bathed in their acidic blood, taking 1d10 physical damage. This splash covers the ground within Very Close range with blood, and all creatures other than the Burrower who move through it take 1d6 physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A large bear with thick fur and powerful claws.

capacita.testoOriginale: Targets who mark HP from the Bear's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.
Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage and the target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.
When the Bear makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A massive humanoid who sees all sapient life as food.
motivazioniOriginale: Bite off heads, feast, rip limbs, stomp, throw enemies

capacita.testoOriginale: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Ogre. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.
The Ogre's attacks deal direct damage.

Mark a Stress to pick up heavy objects and throw them at all targets in front of the Ogre within Far range. Make an attack against these targets. Targets the Ogre succeeds against take 1d10+2 physical damage. If they succeed against more than one target, you gain a Fear.
When the Ogre marks 2 or more HP, they can rampage. Move the Ogre to a point within Close range and deal 2d6+3 direct physical damage to all targets in their path.

descrizioneOriginale: A roughly humanoid being of stone and steel, assembled and animated by magic.
motivazioniOriginale: Destroy environment, serve creator, smash target, trample groups

capacita.testoOriginale: The Construct can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Construct marks HP from physical damage, they must mark an additional HP.
Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in the Construct's path when they move. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d8 physical damage.
Before rolling damage for the Construct's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll. The Construct can then take the spotlight again.

When the Construct marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d12+2 magic damage.

descrizioneOriginale: An ambitious and ostentatiously dressed socialite.

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to say something mocking and force a target within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (14) to see if they can save face. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is Vulnerable until the scene ends.
Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Courtier convinces a crowd or prominent individual that the target is the cause of their current conflict or misfortune.

descrizioneOriginale: A burly vegetable-person with grasping vines.

capacita.testoOriginale: Slam the ground, knocking all targets within Very Close range back to Far range. Each target knocked back this way must mark a Stress.
Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to pull them into Melee range, deal 1d6+2 physical damage, and Restrain them until the Defender takes Severe damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone.
motivazioniOriginale: Defend territory, harry, protect pack, surround, trail

capacita.testoOriginale: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another Dire Wolf is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d6+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a Fear.
Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 direct physical damage and make them Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.

descrizioneOriginale: Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.
While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.
When the Mosquitoes' attack causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to force the target to mark an additional HP.

descrizioneOriginale: A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Rats within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A human-sized insect with tearing claws and a stinging tail.

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, spend a Fear to deal 1d4+4 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.
When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A clear serpent with a massive head that leaves behind a glass shard trail wherever they go.

capacita.testoOriginale: On a successful attack within Melee range against the Snake, the attacker must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.
Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Snake succeeds against take 1d6+1 physical damage.

Spend a Fear to introduce a d6 Spitter Die. When the Snake is in the spotlight, roll this die. On a result of 5 or higher, all targets in front of the Snake within Far range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d4 physical damage. The Snake can take the spotlight a second time this GM turn.

descrizioneOriginale: A nimble fighter armed with javelins.

capacita.testoOriginale: After making a standard attack, the Harrier can move anywhere within Far range.

When a creature moves into Melee range to make an attack, you can mark a Stress before the attack roll to move anywhere within Close range and make an attack against that creature. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A tall guard bearing a longbow and quiver with arrows fletched in the settlement's colors.
motivazioniOriginale: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

capacita.testoOriginale: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 1d12+3 physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they have disadvantage on Agility Rolls until they clear at least 1 HP.

descrizioneOriginale: An armored guard bearing a sword and shield painted in the settlement's colors.
motivazioniOriginale: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

capacita.testoOriginale: A creature who tries to move within Very Close range of the Guard must succeed on an Agility Roll. If additional Bladed Guards are standing in a line alongside the first, and each is within Melee range of another guard in the line, the Difficulty increases by the total number of guards in that line.
Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they break free with a successful attack, Finesse Roll, or Strength Roll.

descrizioneOriginale: A seasoned guard with a mace, a whistle, and a bellowing voice.
motivazioniOriginale: Arrest, close gates, pin down, seek glory

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight the Head Guard and up to 2d4 allies within Far range.

Countdown (5). When the Head Guard is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC makes an attack roll. When it triggers, all Archer Guards within Far range make a standard attack with advantage against the nearest target within their range. If any attacks succeed on the same target, combine their damage.
When the Head Guard makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang's iconic knives.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.
When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 1d10+1 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A staff -wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.

capacita.testoOriginale: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily Curse them. While the target is Cursed, you can mark a Stress when that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.
Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+3 magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.

descrizioneOriginale: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.

capacita.testoOriginale: Creatures Restrained by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is Restrained and Vulnerable. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A thief with simple clothes and small daggers, eager to prove themselves.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jagged Knife Lackeys within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.

capacita.testoOriginale: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, mark a Stress to also spotlight two allies within Close range.
Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.
Spend a Fear to make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+12 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.
When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal 1d6+6 physical damage instead of their standard damage.
Become Hidden until after the Shadow's next attack. Attacks made while Hidden from this feature have advantage.

descrizioneOriginale: A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow.

capacita.testoOriginale: If the Sniper is Hidden when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal 1d10+4 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain.
motivazioniOriginale: Buy low and sell high, create demand, inflate prices, seek profit

capacita.testoOriginale: A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a Presence Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has disadvantage on future Presence Rolls against the Merchant.
When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a Presence Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A coruscating mass of uncontrollable magic.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Elemental is resistant to magic damage.
Mark a HP to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until their next rest or they clear a HP.
Spend a Fear to transform the area within Very Close range into a diff erent biome. All targets within this area take 2d6+3 direct magic damage.
When the Elemental takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal an amount of damage to the attacker equal to half the damage they dealt.
When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A living flame the size of a large bonfire.
motivazioniOriginale: Encircle enemies, grow in size, intimidate, start fires

capacita.testoOriginale: The Elemental can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. The ground within Very Close range of that point immediately bursts into flames. All creatures within this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8 magic damage from the flames. Targets who succeed take half damage.
Spend a Fear to erupt in a fiery explosion. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against take 1d8 magic damage and are knocked back to Far range.
Three times per scene, when the Elemental moves onto objects that are highly flammable, consume them to clear a HP or a Stress.
When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A crimson-hued creature from the Circles Below, consumed by rage against all mortals.
motivazioniOriginale: Act erratically, corral targets, relish pain, torment

capacita.testoOriginale: The Demon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When a PC rolls a failure with Fear while within Close range of the Demon, they lose a Hope.
Spend a Fear to rain down hellfire within Far range. All targets within the area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d20+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
Before rolling damage for the Demon's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to the Demon's current number of marked HP.
When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: An ambulatory sapling rising up to defend their forest.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Treant is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Treant, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Minor Treants within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A moving mound of translucent green slime.
motivazioniOriginale: Camouflage, consume and multiply, creep up, envelop

capacita.testoOriginale: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

Make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. The target must mark an additional Stress when they make an action roll. If the Ooze takes Severe damage, the target is freed.
When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

descrizioneOriginale: A small moving mound of translucent green slime.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

descrizioneOriginale: A moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.
motivazioniOriginale: Camouflage, consume and multiply, ignite, start fires

capacita.testoOriginale: The Ooze can only move within Very Close range as their normal movement. They light any flammable object they touch on fire.

Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 1d8 magic damage and is Ignited until they're extinguished with a successful Finesse Roll (14). While Ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they make an action roll.
When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Red Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

descrizioneOriginale: A small moving mound of translucent flaming red slime

capacita.testoOriginale: When a creature within Melee range deals damage to the Ooze, they take 1d6 direct magic damage

descrizioneOriginale: A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris.
motivazioniOriginale: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

capacita.testoOriginale: All social actions made against the Noble on their land have disadvantage.
Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4 Bladed Guards, who appear at Far range to enforce the Noble's will.

Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Noble proclaims that the target and their allies are exiled from the noble's territory. While exiled, the target and their allies have disadvantage during social situations within the Noble's domain.

descrizioneOriginale: A charismatic sea dog with an impressive hat, eager to raid and plunder.
motivazioniOriginale: Command, make 'em walk the plank, plunder, raid

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Captain marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.
Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon a Pirate Raiders Horde, which appears at Far range.

Spend a Fear to choose a target who has three or more Pirates within Melee range of them. The Captain leads the Pirates in hurling threats and promises of a watery grave. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target marks 1d4+1 Stress. On a success, they must mark a Stress.
When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: Seafaring scoundrels moving in a ravaging pack.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Raiders have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.
When the Raiders mark 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A thickly muscled and tattooed pirate with melon-sized fists.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Tough marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.
Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to move into Melee range of the target, dealing 3d4 physical damage and knocking the target back to Close range.

descrizioneOriginale: An armed mercenary testing their luck.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Sellsword is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Sellsword, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Sellswords within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A fragile skeleton with a shortbow and arrows.
motivazioniOriginale: Perforate distracted targets, play dead, steal skin

capacita.testoOriginale: When two or more adversaries are within Very Close range of a creature, all damage the Archer deals to that creature is doubled.
Make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 3d4+8 physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A clattering pile of bones.
motivazioniOriginale: Fall apart, overwhelm, play dead, steal skin

capacita.testoOriginale: The Dredge is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Dredge, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Dredges within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A large armored skeleton with a huge blade.
motivazioniOriginale: Cut down the living, steal skin, wreak havoc

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Knight makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.
Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take 1d8+2 physical damage and must mark a Stress.

When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes 1d4+8 physical damage and loses 1d4 Hope.

descrizioneOriginale: A dirt-covered skeleton armed with a rusted blade.
motivazioniOriginale: Feign death, gang up, steal skin

capacita.testoOriginale: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.
When the Warrior is defeated, you can spotlight them and roll a d6. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.

descrizioneOriginale: A mercenary combining swordplay and magic to deadly eff ect.

capacita.testoOriginale: Damage dealt by the Spellblade's standard attack is considered both physical and magic.
Mark a Stress and target a group within Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d8+2 magic damage. You gain a Fear for each target who marked HP from this attack.
Spend 2 Fear to spotlight up to five allies within Far range.
When the Spellblade makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A skittering mass of ordinary rodents moving as one like a ravenous wave.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.
All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.

descrizioneOriginale: A faerie warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.

capacita.testoOriginale: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sylvan Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d8+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage.
Spend a Fear to pull down a tree within Close range. A creature hit by the tree must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take 1d10 physical damage.
When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to become Hidden until the Soldier's next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.

descrizioneOriginale: A cluster of animate, blood-drinking tumbleweeds, each the size of a large gourd.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.
Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+8 direct physical damage to a target with 3 or more bramble tokens.

When the Swarm succeeds on an attack, give the target a bramble token. If a target has any bramble tokens, they are Restrained. If a target has 3 or more bramble tokens, they are also Vulnerable. All bramble tokens can be removed by succeeding on a Finesse Roll (12 + the number of bramble tokens) or dealing Major or greater damage to the Swarm. If bramble tokens are removed from a target using a Finesse Roll, a number of Tangle Bramble Minions spawn within Melee range equal to the number of tokens removed.

descrizioneOriginale: An animate, blood-drinking tumbleweed.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Bramble is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Tangle Bramble, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Tangle Brambles within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

When an attack from the Bramble causes a target to mark HP and there are three or more Tangle Bramble Minions within Close range, you can combine the Minions into a Tangle Bramble Swarm Horde. The Horde's HP is equal to the number of Minions combined.

descrizioneOriginale: An imperious tree-person leading their forest's defenses.

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

Spend a Fear to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and Restrain them until they're freed with a successful Strength Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.
When the Dryad makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A large corpse, decay-bloated and angry.

capacita.testoOriginale: When you spotlight the Zombie and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Zombie and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.
Make a standard attack with advantage against a target the Zombie has Restrained. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.
When the Zombies makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.
When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.
When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.
Mark a Stress to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.
motivazioniOriginale: Devour, hungry, mob enemy, shred flesh

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.
Targets who mark HP from the Zombie's attacks must also mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A group of trained archers bearing massive bows.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Squadron has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d6+3 physical damage instead.
Spend a Fear to target a point within Far range. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Close range of that point. Targets the Squadron succeeds against take 1d10+4 physical damage.

Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Until the next roll with Fear, a creature who moves within Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d6+3 physical damage. On a success, they take half damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A young trainee eager to prove themselves.
motivazioniOriginale: Act reckless, kill, prove their worth, show off

capacita.testoOriginale: The Assassin is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Assassin, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Apprentice Assassins within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A group of shambling corpses instinctively moving together.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Zombies have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.
When the Zombies mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

descrizioneOriginale: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.
motivazioniOriginale: Anticipate, get paid, kill, taint food and water

capacita.testoOriginale: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin's attacks are Vulnerable until they clear a HP.
The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.
Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, Dizzying all targets in this area. Dizzied targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.

descrizioneOriginale: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.
motivazioniOriginale: Ambush, get out alive, kill, prepare for all scenarios

capacita.testoOriginale: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're Hidden.
Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.
When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.
When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A cube-shaped construct with a diff erent rune on each of their six sides.
motivazioniOriginale: Change tactics, trample foes, wait in disguise

capacita.testoOriginale: The Box can be spotlighted up to two times times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

Mark a Stress and roll a d6. The Box uses the corresponding move: 1. Mana Beam. The Box fires a searing beam. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 magic damage. 2. Fire Jets. The Box shoots into the air, spinning and releasing jets of flame. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 2d8 physical damage. 3. Trample. The Box rockets around erratically. Make an attack against all PCs within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 1d6+5 physical damage and are Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope. 4. Shocking Gas. The Box sprays out a silver gas sparking with lightning. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress. 5. Stunning Clap. The Box leaps and their sides clap, creating a small sonic boom. All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable until the cube is defeated. 6. Psionic Whine. The Box releases a cluster of mechanical bees whose buzz rattles mortal minds. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 2d4+9 direct magic damage.
Before rolling damage for the Box's attack, you can mark a Stress to add a d6 to the damage roll. Additionally, you gain a Fear.
When the Box marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 2d8+1 magic damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Skull levitates several feet off the ground and can't be Restrained.
The Skull is resistant to magic damage.
Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take 2d6+4 magic damage.

Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.

descrizioneOriginale: A poorly trained civilian pressed into war.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Conscripts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.

capacita.testoOriginale: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.
motivazioniOriginale: Curry favor, hinder foes, uncover knowledge

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.
Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must spend a Hope to make an action roll.
Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A professional killer-turned-cultist.
motivazioniOriginale: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks

capacita.testoOriginale: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. Mark a Stress to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

Mark a Stress to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power.
motivazioniOriginale: Follow orders, gain power, seek forbidden knowledge

capacita.testoOriginale: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cult Initiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire.
motivazioniOriginale: Cause fear, consume flesh, please masters

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Pack has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.
Mark a Stress to make all targets within Very Close range lose a Hope. If a target is not able to lose a Hope, they must instead mark 2 Stress.
When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.
motivazioniOriginale: Avoid larger predators, shock prey, tear apart

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.
Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.

descrizioneOriginale: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.
motivazioniOriginale: Gain glory, keep order, make alliances

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.
When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.

descrizioneOriginale: A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them warped and ungainly.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.
When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within Very Close range, the Experiment deals double damage.
Mark a Stress to spotlight the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow.
motivazioniOriginale: Command, make a living, maneuver, pin down, protect companion animals

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also spotlight a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can mark a Stress to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll.
Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster's control. The adversary appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

descrizioneOriginale: An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger than a human.
motivazioniOriginale: Make a living, overwhelm, slam, topple

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d4+3 physical damage from the shrapnel.

When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals 2d6+15 physical damage instead of their standard damage.
When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons.
motivazioniOriginale: Hunt prey, stay mobile, strike decisively

capacita.testoOriginale: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.
Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and knock the target over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily Restrained within the Eagle's massive talons. If the target is Restrained, the Eagle immediately lifts into the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

While flying, the Eagle can drop a Restrained target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer Restrained but starts falling. If their fall isn't prevented during the PCs' next action, the target takes 2d20 physical damage when they land.

descrizioneOriginale: A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor.
motivazioniOriginale: Batter, make a living, overwhelm, terrify

capacita.testoOriginale: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A snake-headed, scaled humanoid with a gilded bow, enraged that their peace has been disturbed.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Gorgon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Gorgon makes a successful standard attack, the target Glows until the end of the scene and can't become Hidden. Attack rolls made against a Glowing target have advantage.
Make an attack roll against a target within Melee range using the Gorgon's protective snakes. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 2d10+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they begin to turn to stone, marking a HP and starting a Petrification Countdown (4). This countdown ticks down when the Gorgon is attacked. When it triggers, the target must make a death move. If the Gorgon is defeated, all petrification countdowns end.
When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings moving faster than the eye can see.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.

Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

descrizioneOriginale: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.
motivazioniOriginale: Run down, seek glory, show dominance

capacita.testoOriginale: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they're next spotlighted.
When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.
If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.
Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.

capacita.testoOriginale: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage and the Thief steals one item or consumable from the target's inventory.

Mark a Stress to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within Very Close range of the trap must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. A target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll (13).

descrizioneOriginale: An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their command.
motivazioniOriginale: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend a Fear to off er a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

capacita.nomeOriginale: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
capacita.testoOriginale: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4+1 Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Far range, to enforce the Baron's will.

descrizioneOriginale: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.

capacita.testoOriginale: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

Mark a Stress to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur's path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take 2d6+8 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra 1d6 damage (combine the damage).
Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal 2d8 direct physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a casually cruel demeanor.

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

Spend a Fear to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic Deathlock until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a Deathlocked target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one Deathlock at a time.
Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.

capacita.testoOriginale: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

Mark a Stress to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target's opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor's preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target's motives.

Spend a Fear to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

descrizioneOriginale: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.
motivazioniOriginale: Amass great power, plot, take command

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.
When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

Countdown (6). When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick up this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.
Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

descrizioneOriginale: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.
motivazioniOriginale: Find the blood, isolate prey, target the weak

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature's attack, you can mark a Stress to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

descrizioneOriginale: A half-fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.
motivazioniOriginale: Consume, lure prey, subdue with song

capacita.testoOriginale: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target Entranced by their song, the attack deals 2d10+1 damage instead of their standard damage.

Spend a Fear to sing a song that aff ects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Entranced until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can mark a Stress to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While Entranced, a target can't act and is Vulnerable.

descrizioneOriginale: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is vulnerable.
motivazioniOriginale: Move through solid objects, stay out of the fray, rehash old battles

capacita.testoOriginale: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.
Spend a Fear to make an attack within Far range against a PC who is within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes 2d8+12 physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.
motivazioniOriginale: Move through solid objects, rally troops, rehash old battles

capacita.testoOriginale: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.
Spend 2 Fear to return up to 1d4+1 defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).
When the Captain's Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can mark a Stress to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.
When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.
motivazioniOriginale: Move through solid objects, protect treasure, rehash old battles

capacita.testoOriginale: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.
Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.
motivazioniOriginale: Cut and run, disguise appearance, eavesdrop

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend a Fear to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can mark a Stress to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain 1d4 Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are Hidden and immune to all damage.

While Hidden, mark a Stress to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take 2d8 physical damage and become temporarily Restrained.

Spend a Fear to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take 2d10 physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).
When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A battle-hardened mage trained in destructive magic.
motivazioniOriginale: Develop new spells, seek power, shatter formations

capacita.testoOriginale: Before or after making a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to teleport to a location within Far range.
Mark a Stress to refresh the Wizard's "Warding Sphere" reaction.

Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 2d10 physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't moved.
Spend a Fear to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal 2d6 magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can't be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their "Refresh Warding Sphere" action.

descrizioneOriginale: A winged insect the size of a large house with iridescent scales and wings that move too fast to track.
motivazioniOriginale: Collect shiny things, hunt, nest, swoop

capacita.testoOriginale: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Flickerfly makes an attack, the target's Evasion is halved against the attack.
While flying, the Flickerfly can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.
Spend a Fear to whirl, making an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Flickerfly succeeds against take 3d8 direct physical damage.

Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target's fears.

Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail lose 2 Hope and take 3d8+3 direct magic damage.
When the Flickerfly takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to take half damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A regal cloaked monstrosity with circular horns adorned with treasure.

capacita.testoOriginale: Attacks against the Demon are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This Demon starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the Demon's standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the Demon for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.
Add a bonus to the Demon's attack rolls equal to the number of handfuls of gold they have.
Spend 3 handfuls of gold (or a Fear) to spotlight 1d4+1 allies.

descrizioneOriginale: A cloaked demon-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.
motivazioniOriginale: Make fear contagious, stick to the shadows, undermine resolve

capacita.testoOriginale: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.
Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets aff ected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.
When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.
When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.
motivazioniOriginale: Condescend, declare premature victory, prove superiority

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.
When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.
Mark a Stress to deal the Demon's standard attack damage to a target within Close range.
Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.
When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

descrizioneOriginale: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.
motivazioniOriginale: Join in on others' success, take what belongs to others, hold grudges

capacita.testoOriginale: The Demon's standard attack deals direct damage.
When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.
When a creature within Close range takes damage from a diff erent adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

When a PC takes Severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or consumable of their choice from the target's inventory.

descrizioneOriginale: A hulking demon with boulder-sized fists, driven by endless rage.
motivazioniOriginale: Fuel anger, impress rivals, wreak havoc

capacita.testoOriginale: The Demon's attacks deal direct damage.
Spend a Fear to boil the blood of all PCs within Far range. They use a d20 as their Fear Die until the end of the scene.
When the Demon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

Countdown (Loop 6). Activate the first time an attack is made within sight of the Demon. It ticks down when a PC takes a violent action. When it triggers, summon 1d4 Minor Demons, who appear at Close range.

descrizioneOriginale: A wide-winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.

capacita.testoOriginale: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.
Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.
When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A nature spirit in the form of a humanoid tree.
motivazioniOriginale: Command, cultivate, drive out, preserve the forest

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or deal more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.
Spend a Fear to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.
When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally's life force is returned to the forest.

descrizioneOriginale: A blazing mote of elemental fire.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Elemental is defeated when they take any damage. For every 9 damage a PC deals to the Elemental, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Elemental Sparks within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A living landslide of boulders and dust, as large as a house.

capacita.testoOriginale: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.
An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

Mark a Stress to create a rockslide that buries the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take 2d12+5 physical damage and become Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.
When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A huge living wave that crashes down upon enemies.

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+7 physical damage and the target's next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become Restrained and Vulnerable as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.
When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to knock the target back to Close range.

descrizioneOriginale: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.

capacita.testoOriginale: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.
When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

descrizioneOriginale: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.
The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra's number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.
All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.
When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

descrizioneOriginale: The sovereign ruler of a nation, wreathed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.
motivazioniOriginale: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.
Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

Long-Term Countdown (8). Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A sturdy animate old-growth tree.
motivazioniOriginale: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches

capacita.testoOriginale: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.
Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this eff ect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A small, sentient tree sapling.
motivazioniOriginale: Blend in, preserve the forest, pummel, surround

capacita.testoOriginale: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
motivazioniOriginale: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate

capacita.testoOriginale: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.
A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.
When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.
Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.
When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

descrizioneOriginale: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator's smile.

capacita.testoOriginale: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5d4 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.
When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.

capacita.testoOriginale: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

descrizioneOriginale: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.
motivazioniOriginale: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect

capacita.testoOriginale: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they're within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't knocked back.
When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A massive living turret with reinforced armor and twelve pistondriven mechanical legs.
motivazioniOriginale: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect

capacita.testoOriginale: When you spotlight the Turret and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.
Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.
When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.
When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.
motivazioniOriginale: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul

capacita.testoOriginale: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.
When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.
When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

descrizioneOriginale: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.
motivazioniOriginale: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day, resurrect

capacita.testoOriginale: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you spend a Fear.

Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.
Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

descrizioneOriginale: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen's will.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A powerful mage bound by the bargains they made in life.

capacita.testoOriginale: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.
When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

descrizioneOriginale: A Fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.
motivazioniOriginale: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak

capacita.testoOriginale: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.
Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

Countdown (Decreasing 8). When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.
When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

capacita.nomeOriginale: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
capacita.testoOriginale: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

nome: Signore della guerra caduto: Campione imbattuto
descrizioneOriginale: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.
motivazioniOriginale: Dispatch merciless death, punish the defiant, secure victory at any cost

capacita.testoOriginale: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.
Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.
Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.
When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

descrizioneOriginale: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked Guilty by a High Seraph.
Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

descrizioneOriginale: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
While the Soldier is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.
motivazioniOriginale: Enforce dogma, fly, pronounce judgment, smite

capacita.testoOriginale: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
While the Seraph is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

Spend a Fear to make a target Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While Guilty, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a Guilty target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

Mark a Stress to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked Guilty. Targets who fail take 4d6+12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
Once per scene, spend a Fear to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

descrizioneOriginale: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.

capacita.testoOriginale: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.
